newsitem.title: USA: No controversy in G7 meeting - Waigel.
newsitem.headline: No controversy in G7 meeting - Waigel.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said he expected no major controversies to emerge from the Group of Seven meeting on Sunday.
Speaking to reporters as he arrived in Washington on Saturday, Waigel said in response to a question, "There is nothing controversial."

He declined to comment on whether the G7 would make a formal statement on currencies, telling reporters to wait until a briefing that he and Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer are scheduled to give at 8 a.m. EDT (2200 GMT) on Sunday.
Tietmeyer also arrived in Washington on Saturday, but made no comment to reporters.
